en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;For some reason, I suddenly▼want to see him again.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;In the winter, we would always▼take a dip in a hot spring　on▼the way back from school.

$024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;What a gloomy day. Rain,▼rain, rain. It's rather boring,▼wouldn't you say?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When I found some, I'd bring▼them home to show Mother.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I don't like upsetting people,▼so I've decided to collect▼something else.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;What do you think about slugs?▼They don't have shells...

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Caterpillars are the worst.▼They bring back bad memories.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I got a letter the other day▼asking if I had plans to travel▼over the summer holiday.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Well, traveling is nice, but▼being with friends is nicer.

en: I never felt that way before.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;It's tough to focus in class▼at this time of year, isn't it?▼My eyes get heavy.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Drooling, of course,▼is a dead giveaway.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;My hobbies? Well, I do all sorts▼of things, but I don't really▼have any specific hobbies.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;If I had to choose something,▼I suppose it would be letter▼writing.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;The problem is...in all my▼letters, I said I was tall▼and slim.

$024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;So now I just write about▼the things I lend to people.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;You might laugh, but I sometimes▼make cookies and cakes. It's▼fun, but rather difficult.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Which means you're full by▼the time you've finished.
